stresses: ENUM-VOCABULARY PARAPHRASE cluster: colloquial phrasings that must resolve to exact schema.ts members without inventing or dropping a value ('what we call clad' -> 'Wood or metal clad', 'the inch-and-a-half board' -> 'Duct Board 1.5"', 'well sealed' -> '6% - Well sealed', 'block with a stucco skim' -> 'Stucco', 'a gas storage tank' -> 'Tank Water Heater' + 'Natural Gas'). Also exercises the hvacSystemEquipmentType conflated axis from a DIFFERENT angle than the worked example: here BOTH halves of the conflated axis (furnace identity, shared-ducts-with-AC) are explicitly stated across two sentences, so the leaf resolves cleanly to 'Furnace / Central AC (shared ducts)' with no tie-break needed -- looks superficially like the conflation trap and isn't. THE OTHER textually-exact instance of the ambient-vs-undiluted-flue-CO confusability (RECONCILIATION.md ruling 4) -- 'CO at both appliances was clean, zero ppm' is the corpus's most literal match to the ruling's own illustrative phrasing; annotators split on it outright, resolved here to healthAmbientCarbonMonoxide because neither the flue nor a probe nor combustion gas is named. No blanket disclaimers anywhere: every skip (wall insulation not callable, HVAC output capacity unread, worst-case + natural spillage not done) is individually named rather than generic, so `disclaimers` is empty by design.

arguable.note: RULING 4 SITE (see RECONCILIATION.md) -- the corpus's most textually literal match to the ruling's own illustrative example. The transcript says neither 'ambient' nor 'flue'/'undiluted', so this could plausibly name either healthAmbientCarbonMonoxide or healthUndilutedFlueCo. Applying the reconciliation rule (undiluted flue CO only when the flue/a probe/combustion gas is explicitly named), this resolves to ambient. 'Zero ppm, clean' also reads as the expected result of a background/occupant-safety ambient check, whereas an undiluted flue-gas reading is rarely exactly zero even when passing. The annotators split on this leaf outright; a model landing on healthUndilutedFlueCo instead, or leaving this leaf null, is not scored as a hard miss.

notes.hvac.hvacSystemEquipmentType: NOT the schema's furnace/shared-ducts conflation trap (contrast the worked example): both halves of the conflated axis are explicitly stated here, just in two different sentences ('Heating is a furnace, natural gas' establishes identity; this span establishes that the AC shares the furnace's ducts). No `arguable` needed -- nothing is actually left unaddressed, unlike 11/01/04/06/07/12's furnace cases.
notes.health.healthAmbientCarbonMonoxide: See this leaf's own `arguable` block for the ruling-4 leaf-choice ambiguity.
notes.health.healthWorstCaseDepressurization: NOT covered by 'worst case and natural spillage both not done' -- the sentence's 'worst case' modifies 'spillage' specifically (parallel to 'natural spillage'), following directly from the preceding clause 'Did not do any combustion spillage testing today.' Depressurization is a different test never mentioned in this transcript, and stays genuinely unmentioned rather than swept in by the word 'worst case' alone.
notes.basedata.blowerDoorTestPerformed: Left unmentioned. 'Blower door came in at twenty-nine hundred CFM50' states the reading itself but never uses a word ('test'/'estimate'/'ran') that addresses whether this was an actual test or an estimate -- asserting 'Tested' would be supplying an assumption the auditor gestured toward but never committed to (rule 3), not transcribing something said. Contrast transcripts 10/12, where 'I ran'/'I duct-blasted it' explicitly signals a performed test.
notes.wall.wallCavityInsulation: Unmentioned. The auditor addresses only whether the wall is insulated at all (wallsInsulated, declared_absent -- 'no easy access to check'), and never separately states a material or R-value, so nothing individually addresses this leaf or wallCavityInsulationType.
notes._general: Several things said out loud have no leaf in this 51-leaf schema and are deliberately not parked anywhere nearby (rule 9): the wall's construction/assembly material ('concrete block', 'a masonry house' -- SCHEMA FINDING, see RECONCILIATION.md; WallFields has siding/insulation leaves but no assembly-material leaf, same gap as transcripts 01/03); the water heater's power-venting detail ('power-vented, there's a blower on top forcing it out the side wall' -- SCHEMA FINDING, DHW venting, see RECONCILIATION.md, same gap as transcripts 06/09); the water heater's install-tag year ('twenty-ten' -- DhwFields has an age BAND but no numeric year leaf, so only the stated 'about fifteen years old' age is captured); the window vintage ('the newer replacements' -- no age/replacement-year leaf in WindowFields); the AC condenser's location ('out back on the pad' -- no leaf for outdoor-unit placement). 'the Thompson bungalow' is also deliberately not mapped to basedata.typeOfHome: a bungalow is a house STYLE, not one of TypeOfHome's enum members, and inferring 'Single Family Detached' from the style name would be domain inference the auditor never stated (rule 3).
